Homozygous in three Argentinean patients, including two siblings. Later overexpression experiments found reduced protein abundance; lectin changes were not statistically significant.
Homozygous in Saudi Arabian neuromuscular families; reported nucleotide representations vary with normalization.
The missense allele was initially a VUS; parental testing established trans phase and allele-specific protein-expression studies supported its functional effect in the Swedish infant.
